name: Guest Waiver
consent_html: I am 18 or older (or a parent/guardian signing for a minor). I understand a golf swing carries risk, that one person swings at a time and everyone else stays behind the marked line, that only the operator's clubs and balls are used, and that {{custom_values.business_name}} staff may pause play for safety. I take part at my own risk and release {{custom_values.business_name}} from claims arising from my participation, except for its own negligence. I agree {{custom_values.business_name}} may text me about future events (reply STOP any time).
footer_html: Thanks for signing. Grab a club when it's your turn.
thankyou_html:
You're in.

Waiver signed. Have fun, and one swing at a time.
_note: Forms do not render {{custom_values.*}} in consent text on the standalone widget; build_form is fed a per-client copy with Business Name substituted (see build/build_docs_workflows.py caller).

header.title: Guest Waiver
header.subtitle: Takes 20 seconds. One swing at a time, and you're on.
